 Al Pacino, 86, sports head injury as he leaves night out with Noor Alfallah, 32
 Hannah Furnell Updated 2026년 11월 4일 수 오후 7:46 UTC 0 Al Pacino and Noor Alfallah were spotted on a date night (Image: BACKGRID) Former couple Al Pacino and Noor Alfallah were spotted on a night out
 Al Pacino sported a bump on his head as he drove home from a night out with Noor Alfallah.
 On Monday, November 2, the 86-year-old Hollywood icon and the 32-year-old film producer were spotted leaving Chateau Marmont together after a night out in Los Angeles. As photographers captured their departure, Alfallah was all smiles, waving from the driver's seat, while Pacino rode shotgun beside her.
 However, despite the pair appearing in good spirits, there was a glaring, even concerning, detail in the photos. Pacino, who donned a dark suit and sunglasses, appeared to have an angry red gash across his forehead that was visibly raised. The Express US has reached out to the representatives of The Godfather alum for comment on the apparent injury and did not immediately receive a response.
 Al Pacino proves he's still got it at 86 as he turns head of blonde passerby 
 Al Pacino, 86, and girlfriend Noor Alfallah, 32, make rare appearance at Dior fashion show 
 Despite Pacino and Alfallah having been romantically involved, the actor clarified in an October 2024 interview with People that they now share only a close friendship as they co-parent their three-year-old son, Roman.
 Asked whether he was in a relationship, he replied, "No. I have friendship." His representative later confirmed that the duo remained close friends and co-parents.

On Monday, November 2, the 86-year-old Hollywood icon and the 32-year-old film producer were spotted leaving Chateau Marmont together after a night out in Los Angeles. As photographers captured their departure, Alfallah was all smiles, waving from the driver's seat, while Pacino rode shotgun beside her.

 Al Pacino appeared to have a gash on his forehead (Image: BACKGRID) Despite Al Pacino and Noor Alfallah appearing in good spirits leaving Chateau Marmont, there was a glaring detail in the photos taken of the pair. Pacino, who donned a dark suit and sunglasses, appeared to have an angry red gash across his forehead that was visibly raised. The Express US has reached out to the representatives of The Godfather alum for comment on the apparent injury, but did not immediately receive a response.
 Noor Alfallah and Al Pacino were previously romantically linked (Image: GC Images) Al Pacino and Noor Alfallah were previously romantically involved, but the Hollywood actor clarified in an October 2024 interview with People that they now share only a close friendship as they co-parent their three-year-old son, Roman, who was born in June 2023. When asked whether he was in a relationship, he replied, "No. I have friendship." His representative later confirmed that the duo remained close friends and co-parents.
 Noor Alfallah and Al Pacino are close friends who attend events together (Image: Getty Images for Christian Dior) In September, Al Pacino and Noor Alfallah posed together for a photograph shared on Instagram, with the producer celebrating their bond as parents to their son, Roman. The image was captioned, "Roman's Mom & Dad." Alfallah tagged the Lucas Museum of Narrative Art as the location. In May, the pair stepped out together to attend Dior's fashion show. On May 13, Jonathan Anderson debuted his Cruise 2027 collection in Los Angeles. For the Hollywood-themed event, the creative director filled the front row with the industry's biggest stars, including Sabrina Carpenter, Anna Taylor-Joy, Pacino, and Alfallah.
 Al Pacino and Noor Alfallah met at a dinner party in the late 2010s (Image: AFP via Getty Images) In March 2024, Noor Alfallah opened up about the origins of her romance with Al Pacino in an interview with Vogue Arabia. The pair met at a dinner party in the late 2010s. "I thought, wow, that's Al Pacino. I went to film school, so I wasn't dumb about who he was," she recalled. "He's a very talented and unique person. But I had no intention of thinking like, oh, he is going to be my son's father one day." Pacino and Alfallah then began to spend more time together during the COVID-19 pandemic. "Al lives down the street from my house and we started spending every day together, playing chess and watching movies. It was like film school with Al Pacino," Alfallah added. "I guess it just became something more." The former couple was first linked in 2022.
 Al Pacino and Noor Alfallah were no longer an item by 2024 (Image: Getty Images for Lucas Museum of Narrative Art) Despite some outlets reporting that Al Pacino and Noor Alfallah split in September 2023, a few months after Roman's birth, a rep for the actor denied a breakup at the time, telling People, "They are still together." The rep added that, at the time, the pair had worked out a legal custody arrangement for their son. Alfallah subsequently spoke about Pacino in an October 2025 exchange with TMZ . She said they spent time together daily. However, she did not confirm a romantic reconciliation. "Who doesn't want to be together with him? He's the coolest guy," she told the outlet.
 Al Pacino has never married (Image: Richard Shotwell/Invision/AP) In his new memoir Sonny Boy , Al Pacino opened up about his relationships and his avoidance of marriage, which he calls "an entrance to the pain train." He wrote, "Everything's a ticket to the pain train. A ticket or nothing. Are you going to go or not? No, I'll stay here. I'll stay here at the station, I'm not getting on." Marriage, he says, "can suit you, by all means. I just didn't feel it ever suited me for some reason."
 Al Pacino still feels that marriage doesn't suit him (Image: Getty Images) Al Pacino still feels that marriage doesn't suit him. The Oscar winner added, "I loved living together, and then... It depends on who you are getting along with. If you live together with someone, there's got to be... You have to have this communion. If you don't, it's almost an invasion. So I like to know that if I find a human that I can connect with." Pacino says he has many friendships. "I have friends all over the place. I must say I'm very lucky with that," he writes. The actor is also father to daughter Julie, 34 (with acting coach Jan Tarrant), and 23-year-old twins Anton and Olivia (with Beverly D'Angelo).
